description_expanded: Overview5.0(3 reviews)SEAGROVE – Emerald Hill 21 Cozy Studio | Poolside | Sleeps 4 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Emerald Hill 21, a charming condominium studio that perfectly blends comfort and convenience. Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, this cozy retreat offers a serene escape for romantic getaways or small family vacations. With space for up to 4 guests, Emerald Hill 21 features a private patio, ideal for enjoying the peaceful tropical surroundings. The fully equipped kitchen allows for easy meals, though the fantastic local dining options may tempt you to explore nearby culinary delights. Just steps away, you'll find private beach access, as well as a community pool for refreshing dips after beach adventures. Emerald Hill offers the best of both worlds; seclusion and convenience. Enjoy the tranquility of Seagrove Beach, with Seaside and the vibrant attractions of 30A close by. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax on your private patio, perfect for leisurely relaxation amidst the tropical landscape. Beach access is just steps away, providing easy access to the pristine sands of the Emerald Coast. The community pool is perfect for a refreshing swim after a day at the beach. HOME FEATURES Studio with 1 bathroom | Sleeps 4 Private patio Fully equipped kitchen Central air conditioning Complimentary high-speed WiFi Convenient ground-floor location DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Steps from Seagrove Plaza with dining, shopping, and cafes Close to family-friendly State Parks for outdoor adventures Convenient access to Seaside and Rosemary Beach dining and shopping WHY STAY HERE? Ideal for small families or couples Perfect location close to the beach, dining, and shopping Cozy and comfortable with a private patio for relaxation SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 1 Queen bed with a sleeper sofa in the studio Emerald Hill 21 offers the ultimate coastal living experience with unmatched convenience and easy access to all that 30A has to offer. Your peaceful getaway on the Emerald Coast awaits!Show less
